correctness.rationale: Marking one r-cycle weights a permutation by its exact count C_{n,r}; the n!/r labeled choices leave a uniform permutation on n−r labels. The mixed first moment and E[C_{n,r}]=1/r follow, including r=n with M_0=0. Uniform insertion into a specified longest cycle has conditional probability M_k/(k+1), and the longest length cannot decrease in the other cases. The uniform length of the cycle of label 1 gives a_k≥(k+1)/2 and thus a_n−a_m≥r/2 for m=n−r≥1. For r≤m, on all 1≤x≤m, (r−x)_+≤r(1−x/m); hence the capped-mean uplift is at most r(m−1)/(2m)<r/2, including n=2,r=1. For r>n/2 the cap fixes the maximum at r, giving the exact sign and any zero case without needing nonintegrality of a_n. The Golomb–Dickman limits follow by division by n and by r respectively, with the stated exclusions.
residual_risks: No conclusion about the existence of an integer zero case, or a universal eventual sign when r_n/n approaches the critical ratio.
